name: reflex-xy-charts
description: Create native XY charts in Claude with Colorset 1 by default, optional Colorset 2, and an interactive MCP Apps preview.
long_description: Generate charts from your supplied data with Python XY 0.0.8. Read the bundled reflex-xy skill, select from the renderer's preset catalog or a declarative chart specification, and download interactive HTML, native SVG/PNG, editable Python, and JSON. Every new request defaults to Colorset 1; Colorset 2 requires an explicit request or palette selection. The local extension uses a bundled Node MCP server and uv for the pinned Python environment. Chart rendering runs on the machine running this server. Exported HTML is an interactive snapshot; Python callbacks need a live Python host.

tools.name: xy_open_chart_app
tools.description: Open the chart workspace with a clearly labelled Colorset 1 sample through a compatible app entrypoint.

tools.name: xy_render_chart
tools.description: Render supplied data with native XY and an interactive chart preview.

tools.name: xy_recolor_chart
tools.description: Switch an existing chart between Colorset 1 and Colorset 2 from its app interface.

tools.name: xy_get_chart_artifact
tools.description: Return an original chart export to the application for host-mediated file saving.

tools.name: xy_get_reference
tools.description: Read a compact reference from the bundled reflex-xy skill.

tools.name: xy_capabilities
tools.description: List the renderer's supported presets, factories, marks, components, and limits.

uvExecutable.title: uv executable
uvExecutable.description: Executable name or absolute path for an installed uv. Its first render may download the pinned Python dependencies.

artifactDirectory.title: Chart artifact directory
artifactDirectory.description: A writable local directory for temporary chart data and generated HTML, SVG, PNG, Python and JSON files. The server expires chart records after 20 minutes.
